facts.label: reported
facts.quote: The Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) has registered a case against Future Retail Ltd and its promoters, Kishore Biyani and his brother Rakesh Biyani, over an alleged bank fraud of ₹904.32 crore involving the State Bank of India (SBI), PTI reported.
facts.text: The Central Bureau of Investigation registered a case against Future Retail Ltd and promoters Kishore and Rakesh Biyani over an alleged bank fraud amounting to ₹904.32 crore.

facts.label: reported
facts.quote: According to the PTI report citing CBI officials, SBI's complaint alleged that the accused entered into a criminal conspiracy to obtain credit facilities from the bank and a consortium of nine lenders.
facts.text: State Bank of India's complaint highlighted that the credit facilities were secured from SBI alongside a consortium of 9 lenders.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: According to the bank's complaint, the forensic auditor identified 13 related and connected entities to which FRL made net payments of ₹5,878.28 crore during the review period.
facts.text: A forensic audit identified 13 related and connected entities that received net fund transfers of ₹5,878.28 crore from Future Retail.

facts.label: official
facts.quote: Gross payments to these entities stood at ₹24,002.09 crore against receipts of ₹18,123.79 crore.
facts.text: Future Retail routed gross disbursements of ₹24,002.09 crore to the identified connected entities against inward receipts of ₹18,123.79 crore.

Aapko lagta hai bank ke doobe loan ka asar sirf bank par hota hai?
Yeh investment advice nahi hai.
Us dost ko bhejo jo kehta hai, bank ki baat mujhe kya.
